scope: Core-batch deepening after complexity triage. First municipality completed: Ede. Eindhoven and Enschede remain standalone tracks.

legalFramework: Hospitaverhuur: owner may rent at most two rooms, max one person per room; permit-free where the Omgevingsplan allows residential use.

Kamerverhuur: two or more single persons with separate rooms/shared facilities; permit-free in areas with functions Gemengd, Gemengd-1 through 14 or Centrum; elsewhere an omgevingsvergunning may be requested.

Soft dwelling sharing by multiple households is permit-free in specified mixed/centre areas if the Omgevingsplan allows it; elsewhere a permit may be possible under Programma Beter benutten bestaande woningvoorraad 2025.
Urban dwelling splitting generally requires an omgevingsvergunning and has explicit minimum size, access, privacy, environment, parking/bicycle and Bbl conditions.
Rural dwelling splitting requires an omgevingsvergunning and includes no enlargement, 300 m2 demolition-credit per extra dwelling, max four dwellings and environmental/neighbour protections.
Kavel splitting always requires an omgevingsvergunning; urban rules include spatial fit, garden, building line, environment, parking and possible ecology study.

application.authentication: DigiD for individuals; eHerkenning for businesses/institutions
application.preApplication: concept request for dwelling splitting/sharing/temporary dwelling; global assessment for parcel splitting
application.confirmedDocumentsRule: The Omgevingsloket application itself indicates which attachments are required; no static list is invented.
knownPotentialStudiesAndDesignInputs: Bbl building-safety items including escape routes, fire/smoke alarms, sound insulation, ventilation and daylight
ecological study may be required for parcel splitting
rural splitting may require demolition-credit evidence
